# SHA256 of the tools CI downloads, pinned here on purpose.
#
# Recording them here rather than fetching them is the point. A checksum
# published beside the artifact proves nothing, because whoever could replace
# the binary could replace that file with it. These live in the repo, so if a
# published artifact ever changes, CI fails instead of running it.
#
# Mostly there is nothing upstream to compare against anyway: shellcheck and
# shfmt publish no checksums, and Ghostty signs its source tarballs with
# minisign but not the macOS build CI actually runs. actionlint is the
# exception and does publish a checksums file; its two hashes below were
# confirmed against it when pinned, which is worth doing once at that moment
# even though it cannot be trusted as an ongoing check.
#
# The workflow refuses to install a file it has no line for here, which means a
# new OS or architecture fails loudly rather than silently skipping the check.
# Only Apple Silicon macOS is listed, because that is all this repo targets; if
# the runner image ever changes architecture, that is how you will find out.
#
# The Ghostty pin does double duty: it is also the parser the config is
# validated against. Adopt an option from a newer Ghostty and CI will correctly
# reject a key this version does not know, so bump it here and in ci.yml
# together.
#
# To update after bumping a version in ci.yml, download the artifacts and run
# `shasum -a 256` (macOS) or `sha256sum` (Linux) over them.

105f63ec2df9b53cd5dd1f685434d1924163fd4bcf23ecb1b07df343e79d2077  ghostty-1.3.1-macos-universal.zip
56affdd8de5527894dca6dc3d7e0a99a873b0f004d7aabc30ae407d3f48b0a79  shellcheck-v0.11.0.darwin.aarch64.tar.xz
9680526be4a66ea1ffe988ed08af58e1400fe1e4f4aef5bd88b20bb9b3da33f8  shfmt_v3.13.1_darwin_arm64
